jobDescription: Our soft-services division holds the reception, security-desk and visitor management contract for a research park with nine buildings and around 3,000 staff. The Front-of-House Services Supervisor plans desk cover for normal operations and peak events, manages the frontline staff through the attendance, conduct and grievance procedures, runs the visitor and contractor badge process, and reports service levels to the client's estates team each month. Applicants need a recognised supervisory qualification. The park hosts laboratory visitors and contractors every day, so the badge process is audited by the client's security adviser twice a year, and the supervisor is the first point of contact when an audit finding is raised against the front-of-house service.
requirements: Plans reception and security-desk cover across normal operations and peak events.
Manages frontline staff through attendance, conduct and grievance procedures in line with HR policy.
Runs the visitor management system and the contractor access-badge process.
Reports monthly service levels to the client estates team and agrees corrective actions where targets are missed.
Holds a recognised supervisory or leadership qualification.

evidence.text: Front-of-house supervisor for Kestrel Integrated Services on a university campus contract with six reception points and two security desks, September 2021 to present.
Planned reception and security-desk cover for term time and vacation periods, adjusting the rosters for open days and graduation week.

Administered the visitor management system, issued contractor access badges against the approved contractor list and ran a weekly audit of badges not returned, chasing each one with the sponsoring department.
Compiled the monthly service-level report (desk opening compliance, visitor wait times, badge audit results) for the client's estates team.
Supervised 26 reception and security staff, holding attendance reviews and conduct conversations under the contractor's HR policy.

Work sample: the anonymised February 2024 service-level report with desk opening compliance by building, average visitor wait times and the badge audit, followed by the estates team's acknowledgement email.

Reference check summary: the former contract manager confirmed in writing that between March 2022 and July 2024 the candidate chaired the stage-one grievance meetings for the reception team, followed the contractor's grievance procedure and filed each outcome letter with HR.
HR verification note: the candidate's ILM Level 3 Certificate in Leadership and Management was checked through the awarding body's learner verification service and is recorded as achieved in 2023.
